THERMO KING UK is growing
Thermo King UK has expanded with 3 new service locations ( previously known as Thermo King Northern.)
Consistently meeting the needs of our customers for over 50 years, Thermo King UK is firmly established as one of the most respected names within the UK commercial vehicle industry.
We have been at the forefront of the commercial vehicle distribution industry from the early days in the 1970’s, right through to today’s state-of-the-art technology that drives this industry forward.
The standard in sales, installation and support
Tail lift servicing and repair
We also have the UK’s largest network for the servicing of tail-lift equipment, offering nationwide breakdown and maintenance cover for tail lifts, lifting decks, VGB couplings and shutter doors.
We offer onsite LOLER examinations, weight/load testing to keep your fleet legally compliant along with diagnostics, insurance assessments and commercial work.
anywhere, always there!
Supported by a national call centre operating 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, our team of over 200 mobile engineers offers unrivalled breakdown assistance, repair, and routine maintenance on refrigeration units for transport fleet operators across the UK.
We offer a wide range of temperature control systems for various modes of transport, including vans, trucks, trailers, rail cars, aircraft, ships and intermodal containers.
In addition to this, we also have a range of HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) products for metro cars, train cars and buses. We strive to provide reliable and efficient solutions to maintain optimal temperature and comfort in various transport environments.
To ensure high-quality products and service, all Thermo King products are supported by an extensive dealer network. Our dealers offer expert service by factory-trained technicians as well as a full range of genuine and competitively priced spare parts. We are proud to offer an end-to-end solution that not only meets your temperature control needs, but also ensures reliability and support throughout the product’s lifetime.
More about Thermo King
What we offer
Large Truck Refrigeration
Small Truck Refrigeration

Thermo King UK (previously Marshall Fleet Solutions and TK Northern) is the UK’s largest independent commercial vehicle service organisation, keeping customers across the distribution industry on the road by providing nationwide sales, installation, service, and parts support.
We are a long-established dealer of premium Thermo King and Frigoblock refrigeration units for light commercial vehicle, truck and trailer applications, as well as being main dealers for most manufacturers of tail lifts sold in the UK.
Supported by a national call centre operating 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, our team of over 300 engineers offers unrivalled breakdown assistance, repair, and routine maintenance for transport fleet operators across the UK.
With unrivalled expertise, we work extensively with customers to match the products we supply to their specific needs and operating environments – all of which is backed up by the largest and most experienced dedicated installation and service team within the UK transport refrigeration industry.
In line with our strong commitment to sustainability, we are investing in broadening our product range and expertise in electrification, energy recovery and biofuels.
With over 300 engineers, together with a national call centre in operation 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, we offer unrivalled breakdown support, repair and routine maintenance for transport fleet operators anywhere in the UK.
Our service centres offer national coverage and are backed by mobile service vehicles, providing a superb level of commitment to the company’s extensive and growing customer base.
We take training very seriously
Being the UK’s longest-established and largest Thermo King and Frigoblock sales and service dealer, and provides its engineers with the only fully factory-supported Thermo King transport refrigeration training programmes currently available in the UK. We are proud to have our own in-house training school – the industry-leading Centre of Excellence at the Tamworth site.
Responding to the rapidly changing technology and the need for highly trained technicians, we provide a mixture of workshop and classroom training, supported by continuous online training and assessment programmes. Our engineers benefit from bespoke practical training covering every element of transport refrigeration, including electrical training.
With over 20 different courses, ranging from basic refrigeration through to advanced training for multi-temperature truck and trailer systems, together with vehicle-powered and electric units, our product training is the gold standard of the industry.
Supporting continuous development & growth
To maintain the consistency and quality of customer service from our refrigeration and tail lift engineers, the company operates one of the most developed and bespoke training programmes within the commercial vehicle industry.
By investing heavily in planned individual training, we add value to not only to the business and its customers, but also to the individual engineer.
With impressive in-house training facilities at our state-of-the-art Centre of Excellence in Tamworth, and structured programmes created specifically for our front-line engineering teams, our engineers benefit from continuous learning to gain specialist qualifications and lifelong skills.
Every day our engineers are involved in active learning in the classroom, in the workplace and online, using the latest technology to learn and develop the skills required for the future.
Our training programmes provide a roadmap for engineer development, delivering results for all skill levels – from fully experienced engineers through to specific training for individuals onboarding from other backgrounds, as well as developing cross-training skills across different disciplines.

Leading UK distributor and installer of fleet refrigeration systems
We provide transport fleets around the UK with sales and installation for a comprehensive range of leading Thermo King and Frigoblock refrigerated transport systems and products, as well as service, parts and after-sales support. Our clients include food manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers and retailers using vans, trucks and trailers of different sizes, configurations and ages.
Our highly competitive premium reefer units are available in hydrocarbon/biofuel, hybrid and electric variants and can cater to single, dual or multi-temperature requirements. Additionally, all our Thermo King engine powered are fully compatible with HVO fuel.
No matter what your operating requirements are, our sales team can help you find the perfect solution to maximise your fleet’s uptime, reduce your carbon footprint and achieve superior temperature management to minimise the risk of temperature-related damage.
